final_text: General Fund postings were $591.5m in November 2025, up 2.2% from $578.6m in November 2024. Year-to-date postings were $3.50bn, up 2.1%. The largest movements were: Fire increased by $13.6m; Police increased by $6.4m; Non-Departmental - Liability Claims decreased by $6.0m.
